title: Stop refuses to end a turn with an open CI run and no check-in set
why: CI waits have no enforcer: a session can end its turn on an open run with no check-in, and nothing wakes it.
source: Degen report on claude-settings (owner pasted 20:51 CST Nov 12), relayed by the retrospective 21:04 CST; ledger plans/degen-report-2026-11-12.md on branch restart-plan, commit 113d77849, row D6
note: Stop hook half only. The wake half stays on step red-job-wakes-runner (#2860). Ledger row D6. Started by coordinator 21:07 CST Nov 12. 09:06 CST Nov 13, retrospective sighting: one-time check-ins from send_later stopped firing. trig_014EUq set for 07:05 CST had not fired by 07:39; trig_014YkB2LDheNm2NjEzNemC7y set for 08:30 CST was still enabled with no last run at 09:03; runner 10's 13:17Z check-in also never fired. The seven earlier ones tonight (02:49 to 06:20 CST) fired within 2 minutes. Cause unknown; nothing was missed, because runner 10's messages covered every batch event. A rule that waits on a check-in can stall when one never fires. If a platform cause is confirmed, it goes to step upstream-session-raises. Retro 09:54 CST Nov 13: check-in trig_01SKYqWYMpWRtBGEvVzBTThk (send_later, set 09:05, due 09:45:00 CST) fired 09:52:50 CST, 7 min 50 s late. Tally today: 7 on time until 06:20 CST, then 07:05 and 08:30 missed or late, and this one late (7 on time, 3 late or missing). Cause unknown; the step's check must not assume a check-in fires on time.
